name: Navbar
description: A native navigation bar for your dashboards. It shows which page you're on and opens pages, menus and kiosk actions.
author: dimatx

settings.title: Position
settings.description: The screen edge the bar sits on.

settings.title: Labels
settings.description: Text under the icons.

settings.title: Opacity
settings.description: Lower lets the dashboard show through.

settings.title: Swipe to tuck away
settings.description: Swipe the bar toward the edge to tuck it into a small tab.

settings.title: Tuck away after
settings.description: Without a tap. 0 keeps it open.

settings.title: Hide on
settings.description: Pages without the bar, separated by commas, such as /profile.

settings.title: Label
settings.description: Leave empty to turn this item off.

settings.title: Target
settings.description: A page such as /lovelace/0, an action or a menu. See the README.

settings.title: Icon
settings.description: Optional, such as mdi:home-outline. Picked from the label when empty.

settings.title: Selected icon
settings.description: Optional. Shown while this item's page is open.
